facts.fact: Minister Mutati announced that government approved K255 million to upgrade digital infrastructure and Quality of Service, particularly in rural areas; the report does not say whether this is an appropriation, and gives no budget year (2026 inferred from the in-year announcement).
facts.system: K255 million digital infrastructure and QoS upgrade

note: Funding source and appropriation stage are not stated; one allocated fact only, no comparison or spending figure.

facts.fact: Government approved K255 million (ZMW 255,000,000) for digital infrastructure and Quality of Service upgrades, mainly rural, for 2026; the page gives no approval date, so 2026 is the budget year it assigns and its published date is used.
facts.system: K255 million digital infrastructure and QoS upgrade

note: Same K255m approval as document 1, restated as a budget-line record; stage unclear, no funding source named.

facts.fact: The Appropriation Act, 2025 (Act No. 28, assented 23 December 2025) authorises expenditure for 2026; its catalogue line gives Smart Zambia e-government K1.15bn, ICT development K566.8m and legal identity K325.5m, the schedule figures themselves not being on the page.
facts.system: Smart Zambia e-government and ICT development programmes, 2026 appropriation

note: Companion page; figures come only from its catalogue line, no prior-year figure in this document so no rose or fell, no spending.

facts.fact: The Supplementary Appropriation (2025) Act (Act No. 9, assented 8 August 2025) adds, per its catalogue line, K162m for Smart Zambia e-government and K194.3m for ICT development for 2025; the schedule figures themselves are not on the page.
facts.system: Smart Zambia e-government and ICT development programmes, 2025 supplementary appropriation

note: Companion page; supplementary amounts only, figures from catalogue line, no comparison or spending.

facts.fact: The Appropriation Act, 2024 (Act No. 29, assented 20 December 2024) authorises K217.1bn for 2025; its catalogue line gives Smart Zambia K452.1 million, the schedule itself not being on the page.

note: Companion page; figure from catalogue line only, no comparison or spending.
